basic_details.scholarship_name: Al-Baha University International Student Scholarship (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Education of Saudi Arabia & Al-Baha University (BU)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Al-Baha University Main Campus (Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology, Al-Baha, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology (Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering), Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Science, and Faculty of Administrative and Financial Sciences (clinical medical faculties restricted to Saudi citizens under national policy).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~180 to 250 external international government scholarships awarded annually across university faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Prominent bilateral scholarship allocation; Pakistani students constitute one of the largest international student contingents in Al-Baha (~25 to 40 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor's; 2 years for Master's (plus 1-year Arabic language foundation institute if required)

nationality_requirements: International applicants holding non-Saudi citizenship (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years old; Master's applicants must not exceed 35 years of age at application.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: HSSC / Intermediate (Pre-Engineering, ICS, or General Science) or Cambridge A-Levels for Bachelor's (minimum 80% marks or Grade B); recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree (BS / BE / BSc) in Computing, Information Technology, or Engineering for Master's from an HEC-recognized university with minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00 or Very Good (Jayyid Jiddan) standing.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Transcripts evaluated on the standard Saudi 5.0 GPA scale (minimum 3.75 / 5.00 equivalent).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering or ICS background required for Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology and Faculty of Engineering.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Applicants must have graduated and possess official final transcripts and passing certificates at the time of portal registration.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: High school certificate / intermediate diploma must not be older than 3 to 5 years from application date.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not required; programming portfolio, technical certifications, or publications beneficial for postgraduate applicants.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology programs are taught in English (MOI certificate from Pakistani university accepted; IELTS 5.5+ or TOEFL 65 recommended). Arabic-taught tracks require Arabic proficiency or completion of the university Arabic Language Center.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Intensive 1-year preparatory Arabic language program available for students enrolled in Arabic-medium faculties.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female applicants must either reside with an authorized legal male guardian (Mahram) possessing valid Iqama in Saudi Arabia or obtain admission under institutional residential guardianship in monitored female university dormitories.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Application submission through the unified Saudi government portal 'Study in Saudi' (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicant must not have previously held or been dismissed from another Saudi government university scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee exemption for the entire official duration of academic degree study at Al-Baha University.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~SAR 25,000 to 38,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,875,000 to 2,850,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Application through the official Saudi Ministry of Education 'Study in Saudi' portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free fully furnished on-campus student housing in Al-Baha University residential dormitories (Al-Baha city), including utilities, Wi-Fi, air conditioning/heating, and laundry facilities.

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living stipend disbursed directly into student bank accounts: SAR 840 / month for undergraduate students (~PKR 63,000 / month); SAR 900 to 1,000 / month for postgraduate students (~PKR 67,500 to 75,000 / month).

airfare.details: Free annual economy-class round-trip airfare ticket between Pakistan and King Saud Airport (ABT) in Al-Baha via Jeddah/Riyadh provided by the university at the end of each academic year.

visa_fee.details: Saudi student study visa authorization and governmental Iqama (residence permit) covered fully by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive 100% free medical and emergency healthcare provided at Al-Baha University Medical Center and government hospitals in the Al-Baha Region.

food_allowance.details: Heavily subsidized campus dining halls providing wholesome multi-course meals at SAR 3 to 6 per meal; easily covered by the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free textbook loans and comprehensive digital database access via the Al-Baha Central Library and the Saudi Digital Library.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Postgraduate thesis printing allowance (SAR 3,000 for Master's) and university research deanship funding for computing and AI publications.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university campus shuttle buses operating regularly between university residential halls, faculties, computer laboratories, and Al-Baha city center.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host institution (Al-Baha University, Al-Baha, Saudi Arabia).
participating_institutions: Al-Baha University (Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology, Al-Baha, Saudi Arabia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Scenic public university in southwestern Saudi Arabia established in 2006; QS Arab Region Rankings #111-120; accredited by the National Center for Academic Accreditation and Assessment (NCAAA).
available_majors: Computer Science (Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 4 to 5 years; Master's: 2 years (plus optional 1-year Arabic foundation if needed)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Unified online application through 'Study in Saudi' portal, attested intermediate / bachelor's certificate with minimum 80% marks, police clearance certificate, comprehensive medical fitness report, two academic letters of recommendation, and valid international passport.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology in Al-Baha offers strong programs with modern computing facilities; applicants with high marks (85%+) in mathematics and physics have high acceptance rates.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Ensure complete sequential attestations (IBCC/HEC then MoFA Pakistan) are stamped before scanning documents to guarantee seamless verification on the Study in Saudi portal.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Study in Saudi Official Platform (Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an applicant profile on the 'Study in Saudi' portal (https://studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa/), select 'External Scholarship (منحة خارجية)', choose Al-Baha University as first preference, specify Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology, and upload certified document scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Attest educational certificates (Matric/Inter or BS) through IBCC or HEC, followed by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) Pakistan.
Step 2: Obtain an official police character clearance certificate and a comprehensive medical fitness certificate from an authorized diagnostic lab.
Step 3: Register an account on the Saudi Ministry of Education Study in Saudi portal (https://studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa/).
Step 4: Select Al-Baha University, choose Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology and degree level, and upload all required PDF credentials.
Step 5: Al-Baha University Deanship of Admission reviews applications and submits shortlisted nominations to the Ministry of Education.
Step 6: Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) issues an electronic visa authorization number (Visa Slip / Tafweez).
Step 7: Submit passport for visa stamping via authorized Saudi Visa Service Centers (Etimad / VFS Tasheel) in Pakistan; university issues e-ticket to Al-Baha.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Unified Government System: Single application via the Study in Saudi portal simultaneously processes university academic admission and the full government scholarship award.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded as attested scanned PDF documents on official institutional letterhead bearing referee contact details and official stamps.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Brief statement of purpose (in English or Arabic) detailing academic objectives, passion for computing/technology, and motivation to study in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: For Master's applicants: 2 to 3-page research synopsis outlining proposed thesis domain in computer science or software engineering.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard tabular CV outlining educational qualifications, academic percentage/CGPA, software skills, and extracurricular activities.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Screening is entirely document- and merit-based; no mandatory video interview is conducted for undergraduate external scholarships.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: English proficiency certificate (IELTS/TOEFL) or Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter; no mandatory GRE/GAT required for external admissions.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: IBCC (for Matric/Inter), HEC (for Bachelor degrees), and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) Pakistan attestations are strictly mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Arabic translations of all educational documents, transcripts, and police clearance certificates.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online submission via the Ministry of Education Study in Saudi portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Matric/Intermediate (FSc Pre-Engineering/ICS) for Bachelor's or BS transcript for Master's with minimum 80% marks.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC (for school/college) or HEC (for degrees) and verified by MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official police certificate proving applicant has no criminal record in Pakistan, issued within the last 6 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by local Police Khidmat Markaz / District Police Office and attested by MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Medical certificate proving absence of contagious diseases (HIV, Hepatitis B/C, Tuberculosis, chest X-ray normal).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by a licensed diagnostic center/hospital and attested by a registered medical practitioner.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of passport bio-data page with minimum 2 years remaining validity.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Valid Pakistani passport extending through late 2028 or beyond.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential reference letters from previous school/college teachers or university professors attesting to academic excellence.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Printed on official school/university letterhead with official stamp and referee contact information.

required_documents_checklist.specification: White background passport-sized photographs (4x6 cm) complying with Saudi visa guidelines.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Saudi external scholarship portals open annually between May and July. Security clearance, MOE nomination, and MOFA visa authorization take 4 to 6 months.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (High school / Intermediate aggregate marks or Bachelor CGPA)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 10% (Good conduct record, character references, community activities)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (For postgraduate applicants: research proposal, publications, or computing portfolio)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Motivation letter clarity and alignment with technology goals)
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: 0% (Qualifying check only; no specific score weight)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Merit-based competition governed by bilateral national quotas)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Al-Baha University Deanship of Admission and Registration in coordination with the Saudi Ministry of Education External Scholarship Directorate.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Automated merit ranking based on certified transcript grades, validation of attestations, and allocated national country quotas.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~11,000 to 19,000 international applicants across the Study in Saudi portal
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~180 to 250 international scholarships awarded at Al-Baha University annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4.5% to 6.5% (Pakistan is granted one of the highest external scholarship quotas in the Kingdom)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Marks >= 85% in FSc / ICS / A-Levels or CGPA >= 3.4 / 4.0 in Bachelor degree
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Students with top grades in mathematics and physics, complete IBCC/HEC and MoFA attestations, clean criminal records, and strong references.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani intermediate boards (FBISE, BISE Lahore, BISE Multan, BISE Peshawar) and engineering universities.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Yemen, Egypt, Sudan, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Jordan, Nigeria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized immigration agents claiming to guarantee admission or Saudi student visas for money.
The official and ONLY valid application portal is https://studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa/.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Ministry of Education NEVER charges any fee for scholarship application, admission, or visa processing.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Al-Baha University strictly disclaims any affiliation with educational agencies; direct personal application is required.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IBCC, HEC, and MoFA degree attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 to 25,000.
Medical diagnostic testing and blood screenings in Pakistan: ~PKR 10,000 to 15,000.
Saudi Visa Center (Etimad / VFS Tasheel) biometric service fee: ~PKR 12,000 to 18,000.
Initial pocket money before first monthly stipend disbursement in Al-Baha: ~SAR 500 (~PKR 37,500).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Computing courses in Al-Baha are taught only in Arabic. Reality: Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology courses are conducted in English.
Myth: Students must pay back their tuition if they return to Pakistan. Reality: The scholarship is a non-repayable government grant with zero financial bond.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial social media pages claim applications are accepted year-round; the official Study in Saudi portal strictly operates on an annual summer intake (May-July).

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 / 5.0 (Grade Good / Jayyid) each academic semester to retain full scholarship benefits.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Minimum 75% classroom and laboratory attendance required; falling below 75% results in course disqualification (Hirman) and stipend forfeiture.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester academic audit conducted by the Deanship of Student Affairs prior to releasing tickets and monthly stipends.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is strictly prohibited under Saudi student residence laws (Iqama regulations).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars are expected to return to Pakistan upon graduation; the university issues a final exit visa and complimentary return air ticket.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is terminated and the student is repatriated if dismissed for academic failure, exam misconduct, or violation of Saudi laws.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring between Saudi universities is strictly prohibited under the external scholarship charter.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted only within the same faculty during the first academic year with approval of the College Dean.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum extension of one additional semester may be approved upon Dean's recommendation in case of justified academic delay.
